scenario.title: Test 1: Perfect Eligible Customer
dialogue: Yes, I have a couple of minutes.
It is a residential apartment in Gurgaon.
It is sole ownership under my name.
Yes, all original papers are kept safely at home.
I am salaried as a software architect and my salary is credited directly to my HDFC bank account.
The market value is around 1.2 crore.
I would prefer a 10 year tenure.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Hello Rahul Sharma, good day! I am Priya calling from Home Credit. Am I speaking with Rahul Sharma?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Great! Do you have a couple of minutes to speak right now?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Yes, I have a couple of minutes.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. To check your eligibility, could you please tell me what type of property you own—is it residential, commercial, or industrial?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: It is a residential apartment in Gurgaon.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Got that. Is this property in your sole ownership, or is it jointly owned with someone else?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: It is sole ownership under my name.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Thank you. Do you have the original property documents available for physical verification?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: Yes, all original papers are kept safely at home.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Understood. What is the approximate loan amount you are looking to borrow?

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Could you share whether you are salaried or self-employed, and whether your income is received through bank deposit or in cash?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: I am salaried as a software architect and my salary is credited directly to my HDFC bank account.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Approximately what is the current market value of your property?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: The market value is around 1.2 crore.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: What repayment tenure would you prefer for this loan, between 3 to 15 years?

history.speaker: Customer
history.text: I would prefer a 10 year tenure.

history.speaker: Agent
history.text: Congratulations Rahul Sharma! Based on the preliminary details provided, you meet all the eligibility criteria for our pre-approved Loan Against Property offer. I am now transferring your application to our Senior Loan Expert, who will contact you shortly to share the exact interest rates, customized EMI plans, and assist you with the fast-track paperwork. Thank you for choosing Home Credit, and have a wonderful day!
